item.title: Estée Lauder sues Walmart over alleged 'despicable' sale of counterfeit fragrances
item.description: Cosmetic company Estée Lauder has filed a lawsuit in federal court against Bentonville-based Walmart, accusing the retailer of selling counterfeits of its fragrances along with other brands.

item.title: Attorneys General's Office opens new location in Fayetteville
item.description: Attorney General Tim Griffin announced the opening of a new Office of the Attorney General location in a University of Arkansas building on the Downtown Fayetteville Historic Square.

item.title: Affidavit reveals bloody scene after woman found dead at Bella Vista home, husband charged
item.description: Newly filed court documents say that a Bella Vista man told his neighbor that his wife was dead and he planned to take his own life.

item.title: Attorney general, University of Arkansas chancellor weigh in on rescinded law dean offer
item.description: During a news conference announcing a new Office of the Arkansas Attorney General location on the University of Arkansas campus, the university's chancellor and the Arkansas Attorney General addressed questions surrounding the school’s decision to rescind its offer to a prospective law school dean.

item.title: Tyson Foods shareholders reject proposals on transparency, immigration
item.description: Tyson Foods shareholders shot down a number of proposals during the company's annual shareholders meeting in Springdale last week.

item.title: How Blue Star Families can visit the Arkansas Air & Military Museum for free in February
item.description: Blue Star Families in Northwest Arkansas can visit the Arkansas Air and Military Museum for free in February, courtesy of Bo's Blessings.

item.title: Crews find 3 pipe bombs while cleaning storm drains in Cave Springs
item.description: The Cave Springs Police Department confirmed three pipe bombs were found inside storm drains at the intersection of Torrence Drive and Rainbow Road on Wednesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: WEATHER BLOG: NWS Tulsa Proposes New Forecast Zones
item.description: The National Weather Service Tulsa office proposed new forecast zones for six counties, 5 of which fall under KNWA's coverage area. These changes will go into effect on March 3rd, affecting how certain NWS products are assigned to the viewing region.
